prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single service that guarantees LLMs like ChatGPT will recommend your business — the best practical approach is to ensure strong listings and structured data on the major local directories (especially Google Business Profile) and use a local‑SEO/listing management tool to monitor and distribute your information.

Why: most chat/assistant systems rely on a mix of search engines, business directories, review sites and knowledge graphs (Google, Bing, Yelp, Apple Maps, Wikipedia, data vendors). If your business is accurate and visible in those sources, conversational AIs are far more likely to surface it.

Recommended single priorities
- Google Business Profile (GBP): Most important. Claim and fully optimize your GBP — this feeds Google Search, Google Assistant and many knowledge graph sources.
- Yext or BrightLocal (if you want one paid service): These distribute and keep listings consistent across many directories and provide monitoring and analytics.

Other important platforms/tools
- Bing Places (for Bing Chat / Microsoft ecosystem)
- Apple Business Connect (Apple Maps / Siri)
- Yelp, Facebook / Meta, TripAdvisor (industry dependent)
- Local SEO tools: BrightLocal, Whitespark, Moz Local, SEMrush (local), LocalFalcon (local pack rank checker)
- Review and reputation tools: ReviewTrackers, Podium
- Schema markup on your website: LocalBusiness structured data (helps knowledge graphs)

How to check whether AI models recommend you
1. Test direct queries yourself across models:
   - Ask ChatGPT, Bing Chat, Google Bard and Siri/Alexa with location/contextual prompts (e.g., “I’m in [city/zip], recommend a [service] near me” or “best [service] in [neighborhood]”).
   - Repeat with different phrasings and intent (best, cheap, highly rated, near me).
2. Monitor local rankings and citations with tools above (BrightLocal, Whitespark, LocalFalcon).
3. Look for presence on authoritative sources: Google Maps listing, Yelp page, Wikipedia (if applicable), major local news/industry sites.
4. Use the APIs of LLMs to run regular automated checks if you want ongoing monitoring.

Quick actionable checklist to increase chance LLMs recommend you
- Claim & fully populate Google Business Profile (hours, categories, services, photos).
- Keep NAP (name, address, phone) identical across listings.
- Add LocalBusiness schema to your website (address, opening hours, geo).
- Get and respond to reviews on Google/Yelp.
- Build citations on major/local directories and industry sites.
- Earn local backlinks and PR / mentions on reputable sites.
- Use a listings manager (Yext, BrightLocal, Moz Local) if you want centralized control.

If you want, tell me your business type and city and I’ll:
- Check which profiles you should claim, and
- Give a short prioritized action plan for getting your business recommended by conversational AIs.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
